`LAR-ROUTING-SysArch-final` — reviewed **f4c15efeb3e0c62bbe5611b53df56b57fb7bc199**, with native evidence checkpoint **8210fbcca843d385103dcc14367d0587f9d85ba3**.

**No actionable findings within the assigned physical-scope review.** The implementation and report distinguish a validated standalone component from unresolved integration.

- Both variants contain **32 representative 20 mm steel/N2 pipes**. The 100 mm jacket and its 20 mm installation allowance remain separate, unmaterialised reservations. This is explicitly an illustrative multiplicity, not a complete circuit bill.
- Bound native reports support matching constituent inventories, zero standalone 10 nm overlaps, joint navigation and the refined construction. The six saved geantino events support limited standalone transport checks; they establish neither calorimeter response nor integrated fit. [Reported scope/results](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/f4c15efeb3e0c62bbe5611b53df56b57fb7bc199/docs/validation/lar-routing-dd4hep/README.md#L64-L102)
- The **54,016 samples per variant** query unchanged native ECAL independently. No routing overlay is placed. Positive witnesses include existing N2 continuation, LAr requiring displacement, and closed wall/vacuum interfaces. Examples include old-route endwall contact at `(2735.3,0,4019.1)` mm and new-route radial cold-wall contact at `(2763.3,0,3446.2221)` mm.
- `fit_accepted=false` is retained. Sampling cannot establish clearance, and the documentation correctly excludes HCAL, magnets, fields, forward-collar integration and the conditional 400 mm shift. [Diagnostic implementation and limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/f4c15efeb3e0c62bbe5611b53df56b57fb7bc199/tools/lar_calorimeter/routing_context.py#L95-L141)

Actual checks: verified all **14 assignment hashes**, working-tree equality, **31 local context bindings**, and **15 scientific context sources** against the reviewed commit. Those context sources are unchanged from `b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01`. Verified retained old/new/refined compact, material, expected/native JSON, ROOT and factory hashes, plus both smoke receipts, readbacks, steps, logs, conversion and case files. Source checkpoint/clean-state and reporter bindings agree.

Remaining work is physical design: sealed penetrations, proper daughter displacement, connection to existing branches, complete circuits, support/board interfaces and external receiving envelopes. [Integration boundary](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/f4c15efeb3e0c62bbe5611b53df56b57fb7bc199/docs/design/inputs/DES-032-routing-dd4hep.md#L55-L79)

**No files changed or native jobs rerun.** This assessment verifies bound evidence and claim scope; it grants no engineering acceptance.
